english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice when something is suitable or appropriate for a purpose or situation.

exampleSentences.english: This outfit is proper for meeting clients.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 tou3 saam1 heoi3 gin3 haak3 zau6 ngaam1 laa3

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is suitable or fits the situation.

exampleSentences.english: Wearing this outfit for dim sum is appropriate.
exampleSentences.traditional: 着呢套衫去飲茶就啱喇。
exampleSentences.jyutping: zoek3 ni1 tou3 saam1 heoi3 jam2 caa4 zau6 ngaam1 laa3

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is suitable or right for a purpose or occasion.

exampleSentences.english: This outfit is perfectly suitable for wearing to work.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 tou3 saam1 ngaam1 saai3 faan1 gung1 zoek3

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something suitable, appropriate, or fitting.

exampleSentences.english: This time is apt for us to have the meeting.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個時間好啱我哋開會。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 si4 gaan1 hou2 ngaam1 ngo5 dei6 hoi1 wui2

english.note: Use this when acceptable means suitable, appropriate, or right for a person or purpose.

exampleSentences.english: Is this time acceptable to you?
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 si4 gaan3 ngaam1 nei5 maa3

english.note: Use 啱 as the everyday adjective for something suitable, proper, or appropriate.

exampleSentences.english: This arrangement is a good fit for us.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 on1 paai4 hou2 ngaam1 ngo5 dei6
